svg.title: Decisions cutoffs moved by up to 0.30 between question sets, so they need the full train split
svg.desc: Per-class cutoff that reaches 95% held-out accuracy (five-fold cross-fit, 735-document train draw). With no wrong answers, the cutoff is just the lowest probability of a right answer, so small draws set it.

g.text: Decisions cutoffs moved by up to 0.30 between question sets, so they need the full train split
Per-class cutoff that reaches 95% held-out accuracy (five-fold cross-fit, 735-document train draw). With no wrong
answers, the cutoff is just the lowest probability of a right answer, so small draws set it.
